Nabeel Qureshi

I live in New York City and work at Palantir.

I’ve always been interested in creating a better future for humans; concretely, my interests are in intelligence augmentation through technology, economic development, human flourishing, & art, particularly literature.

I grew up in the UK and previously studied Philosophy, Politics & Economics at Oxford. I helped build GoCardless, a payments company in the UK. For a brief period, I was an economic researcher at the Bank of England, focusing on housing.
